# hiil

A private AI assistant running local LLMs on your desktop. Provides chat, code editing, file search, and workspace management through a canvas-based interface.

## Agent Capabilities

- Send and receive chat messages
- Read and edit files in the workspace
- Search files, conversations, and skills
- Manage conversations (create, rename, delete, pin)
- Insert prompt templates
- Attach images to messages
- Switch between AI models
- Configure system prompt and settings
